summary: RoyaLand filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 20, 2026, offering new details on Palazzo Chronicles, a free-to-play match-3 mobile game set in Piedmont during Italian reunification, expected to launch on iOS and Android in Q4 2026 and supported by in-game advertising. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership mechanics are disclosed. The 6-K is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer product announcement, not a special situation; there is no deal or risk-arb angle to monitor.
